crosscheck_summary.scope: Bounded independent recheck of five remote/product employer groups against saved master_catalog.json assertions, public professional indexes and primary employer/Pega material.
priority_findings: Inadev's advertised Pega CS Developer explicitly supports Pan India remote, but years/pay/application acceptance remain unknown.
Pega SSA23920 is a readable Bangalore employer opening. At four years, the published experience route depends on a master's degree; a bachelor-only profile is below its five-year minimum.
Ness QA3–5 role is hybrid and testing-focused; do not rename it SSA. A separate developer listing requires5+ and is old indexed evidence.
Quavo's identified remote role is United States-only and senior management; general remote benefits do not establish India eligibility.
Booking's2025 transcript explicitly described UIKit. It supports detailed customer-service/API-testing project knowledge, not a verified present-day Constellation rollout or local3–5-person team.

Whether Pega's bachelor minimum can be waived for four years.
